name: Camp Ker-Anna
description_short: A volunteer-run camp in the woods of Cumberland, RI, founded in 1937 for the Scouts of St. Matthew Church in Central Falls and now open to all children. It has run weekly day camp weeks and separate overnight weeks for boys and girls.
